name: expiredButActiveCardCount
definition: The number of enabled physical access credentials (cards) whose expiry date has passed.
population: the enabled card assignments of every person the connected access-control instance lists
evidenceRequiredForTrue: A complete read of the people list in which at least one enabled card assignment is present and every expiry date is readable; the count is then exact (0 when none are expired). A tenant with no enabled card, an error or refused answer, a partial read, or any unreadable date is not measured (a count beside one is only a lower bound).
citations: safeguards/physical-security/acre-security-access-control/expiredButActiveCardCount.py (acre Access Control API, GET /api/f/{instanceKey}/people, CardAssignmentInfo.ExpiresOn and IsDisabled: https://apidocs.acresecurity.cloud/object-model/cardassignmentinfo/)
